He wears grey pants, dark grey shoes, red socks and a blue, white and red shirt. ==Trivia== *'''Isaak''' was inspired by the [https://www.instagram.com/p/DYMVjRijHCz/?img_index=3 character] that was played in the Adidas ''Backyard Legend'' promotion. **The shirt that '''Isaak''' wears is inspired by the Spain away shirt worn during UEFA Euro 1996 held in England. However, there are white pinstripes between the red ones which is not present in the actual jersey. ==Update History== *'''22 May 2026''' - [[v1.91.0]] **'''Isaak''' added. *'''12 June 2026''' - [[V2.0.0|v2.0.9]] **'''Isaak''' removed. {{NarratorNavBox}}
